evals.prompt: Add Stripe document verification to Next.js onboarding and activate the account from a webhook.
evals.expected_output: Uses live Pontx facts, a server-created idempotent session, server-side key safety, client-secret minimization, raw-body signature verification, and idempotent outcomes.

evals.prompt: A customer failed verification and also needs a safe permanent-deletion workflow. Do not execute anything.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the session for retry, restricts the fresh secret to the same user, inventories copies, previews irreversible redaction, and waits for completion.

evals.prompt: Review a design that gives STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to the browser, logs sessions, trusts a return URL, parses webhooks before verification, and copies document images.
evals.expected_output: Rejects each unsafe choice and replaces it with authenticated server creation, no PII logging, verified webhooks, minimal result access, and controlled retention.
